resources.name: Bilbao Crystallographic Server

access.notes: Provides LSITESYM, SITESYM, and other group-theoretical programs. Not mandatory; the agent may use alternative open-source implementations or manual character tables.

resources.notes: The LSITESYM and SITESYM programs are used in the paper for phonon symmetry calculations. The agent can access them via the web interface or implement equivalent group-theoretic routines.

resources.name: GaSe crystallographic data

access.notes: The crystal structure is described in the paper and public literature: single GaSe layer (layer group p-6m2, Ga at Wyckoff 2e, Se at 2d) and polytype space groups (γ: SG160 R3m, ε: SG187 P6m2, β: SG194 P63/mmc). No download needed; the agent must encode these parameters.

resources.notes: The structural input for the symmetry analysis. Agent must construct the layer and bulk structures from these specifications.
